title: GLG Participates in Allica Bank's $155M Series D as Strategic Investor
summary: GLG participated as an investor in UK challenger bank Allica Bank's $155M Series D round, which valued Allica at $1.2B. The round was led by Ventura Capital with participation from GLG, Sona AM, and existing backers TCV and Blue Owl. The investment reflects GLG's strategic activity beyond expert consulting.
whyItMatters: Showcases GLG's role in major PE deal-making, highlighting expert networks as essential due-diligence infrastructure.
